title: Account, Tools and Access: Cloud Shell & gcloud — D5
purpose: Shows what changes at 10x load and where operational cost moves.
routing_rationale: All administrative interfaces (Console, Cloud Shell, gcloud) converge onto the same underlying Google Cloud REST APIs, authenticated via OAuth2 tokens and authorized by Cloud IAM.

nodes.label: Local gcloud SDK
nodes.detail: Local developer workstation running authenticated gcloud CLI commands.

nodes.label: Cloud Shell Container
nodes.detail: Ephemeral Debian container with 5GB persistent $HOME and pre-installed SDKs.

nodes.label: Google API Gateway
nodes.detail: Authenticates OAuth2 bearer tokens and terminates administrative gRPC/REST sessions.

nodes.label: Cloud IAM Policy Engine
nodes.detail: Evaluates roles/viewer or roles/editor permissions against target project.

nodes.label: Cloud Audit Log Sink
nodes.detail: Writes immutable admin activity audit logs with principal email and caller IP.

steps.title: CLI Command Dispatch
steps.action: Engineer runs gcloud command; SDK attaches cached OAuth2 token.
steps.why_traversal: gcloud CLI manages credential acquisition and automatically negotiates API versions.

steps.title: Token & Quota Validation
steps.action: API Gateway verifies token signature with Google STS and evaluates IAM permissions.
steps.why_traversal: Enforces least-privilege role boundaries before executing resource modification.

steps.title: Audit Log Recording
steps.action: API Gateway writes non-repudiable audit event to Cloud Logging.
steps.why_traversal: Enterprise governance requires immutable audit trails for all administrative actions.

scenarios.label: OAuth Refresh Token Expiry
scenarios.root_cause: Developer refresh token revoked by IdP password reset or 16-hour session max.
scenarios.diverted_path: CLI commands fail with HTTP 401 Unauthorized; local scripts halt.
scenarios.blast_radius: Automated deployments using personal credentials fail immediately.
scenarios.recovery: Execute gcloud auth login or switch CI automation to Workload Identity Federation.

scenarios.label: Quota exhausted
scenarios.root_cause: A project or regional quota reaches its allocation limit.
scenarios.diverted_path: Requests surface elevated latency, errors, or denied actions.
scenarios.blast_radius: Consumers of the affected resource or dependency.
scenarios.recovery: Reduce load, restore the dependency, and add a tested prevention.

scenarios.label: Dependency unavailable
scenarios.root_cause: A required API or downstream dependency is unavailable.
scenarios.diverted_path: Requests surface elevated latency, errors, or denied actions.
scenarios.blast_radius: Consumers of the affected resource or dependency.
scenarios.recovery: Reduce load, restore the dependency, and add a tested prevention.
